# City Nomads

> > City Nomads is Singapore's lifestyle and culture guide covering live music, travel destinations across Southeast Asia and Australia, arts, dining, and urban experiences.

Founded by Gary Lim and featuring contributions from Joel Conceicao, City Nomads curates events, concerts, travel guides, and cultural experiences for cosmopolitan explorers in Singapore and beyond. The site covers everything from drag brunches and vinyl culture to day trips in Perth and Bangkok's night markets.

## Key Topics

- Singapore events and concerts
- Southeast Asia travel
- Live music and festivals
- Australia destinations (Perth, Sydney)
- Thailand travel (Bangkok)
- Arts and culture
- Design hotels and staycations
- Cabaret and drag performances
- Vinyl and music culture
- Weekend markets and brunches
- Concert venues (SISTIC)
- Marina Bay Sands events
- British and Irish artists (Damien Rice, Jamie Lawson)
- Urban exploration and walking tours
- Lifestyle experiences

## Travel Guides

- [A travel guide to Perth, Australia: Our pick of 10 things to do](https://citynomads.com/top-10-things-to-do-in-perth-australia): Perth travel guide featuring Fremantle, Kings Park, and Pinnacles Desert
- [Best Day Trips From Sydney](https://citynomads.com/best-day-trips-from-sydney): Sydney day trip guide to Wollongong, Blue Mountains, and Hunter Valley
- [Blissful Bali with The Shanti Collection](https://citynomads.com/blissful-bali-with-the-shanti-collection): The Shanti Collection luxury villas review in Nusa Dua and Seminyak
- [Asiatique - The Riverfront](https://citynomads.com/asiatique-the-riverfront): Asiatique riverfront night market and shopping in Bangkok
- [Smalls](https://citynomads.com/smalls): Smalls jazz bar and rooftop lounge in Bangkok, Thailand
- [Universal Studios Singapore](https://citynomads.com/universal-studios-sentosa-singapore): Universal Studios Singapore theme park guide on Sentosa Island

## Arts & Culture

- [Bras Basah.Bugis: An Art Walk](https://citynomads.com/brasbasahbugis-an-art-walk): Walking guide to Bras Basah.Bugis arts district and museums
